category_title: Preschoolers non-compliant with classroom maintenance routines like toy cleanup and garbage disposal
scenario_title: Refusal to pick up garbage before planned activity
minimal_context: The student is in the classroom and needs to pick up the garbage before starting the next planned activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to pick up the garbage before we start our next activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Plays with objects without permission and starts making a lot of noise.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put those down and focus on the garbage.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Cries and whines instead of cleaning up.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs around the classroom making a lot of noise, completely ignoring the garbage.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to pick up the garbage before we start our next activity.

STUDENT: (Plays with objects without permission and starts making a lot of noise.)

TUTOR: Please put those down and focus on the garbage.

STUDENT: (Cries and whines instead of cleaning up.)

TUTOR: We need to finish this task.

STUDENT: (Runs around the classroom making a lot of noise, completely ignoring the garbage.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When they did not pick up garbage

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Making a lot of noise, running around
